status: Applied in Fold; sampled encoded visual review and numerical checks

patterns.name: same object, complete story
patterns.recipe: Introduce scattered source notes, transform them into the product surface, show those same facts in the result, retain them in the CTA.
patterns.limit: One fictional product concept; no audience retention test.

patterns.name: two-action launch glimpse
patterns.recipe: A primary action creates an understandable result; one secondary control changes that result visibly. Keep cursor land, press, response and read hold explicit.
patterns.limit: Illustrative UI, no actual backend evaluation.

patterns.name: shared geometry at modular seams
patterns.recipe: Use the same generator for outgoing and incoming object geometry; settle before the boundary. Animate the transformation within scenes, then compare neighboring encoded boundary frames.
patterns.limit: Stationary handoff method; it does not validate high-speed moving seams.

patterns.name: paper morph without text distortion
patterns.recipe: Retire text before nonuniform surface scaling; add destination text after the surface settles. Preserve a complete object at each scene boundary.
patterns.limit: Short empty surface intervals must still be reviewed for pacing.

patterns.name: ending with visible work
patterns.recipe: Carry the resulting notes below the final statement and CTA so the opening problem has a visible resolution.

routing: HyperFrames for exact UI, typography, paper transformations. Local Kokoro for narration and procedural audio for score. No video-model test needed for an all-graphic story.
